node.title: Re: Can i mange XML::LibXML to do an include? Or is there another XML module that does it?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
See the documentation of [mod://XML::LibXML::Parser]:

use warnings; use strict; use XML::LibXML; my $parser = XML::LibXML->new(); my $doc = $parser->parse_file("foo.xml"); $parser->processXIncludes( $doc ); print $doc->toString(1); __END__ This is bar.xml!

Update: Alternatively, my $doc = XML::LibXML->load_xml( expand_xinclude => 1, location => "foo.xml" );
